mapper.sql: id,owner_id,purpose,source_type,puzzle_version_id,game_id,game_state_version,CAST(state_snapshot AS CHAR) AS state_snapshot,state_hash,ruleset_version,solver_version,task_status,time_limit_ms,node_limit,memory_limit_mb,termination_reason,lease_token,lease_until,attempt_count,available_time,start_time,finish_time,CAST(stats_json AS CHAR) AS stats_json,error_code,create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM solve_task WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id,task_id,proof_status,winner_side,proof_value,strategy_status,root_node_id,CAST(winning_lines_json AS CHAR) AS winning_lines_json,CAST(stats_json AS CHAR) AS stats_json,verified_time FROM solve_result WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM solve_task WHERE puzzle_version_id=#{puzzleVersionId} AND solver_version=#{solverVersion} AND purpose='ANALYSIS' AND task_status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','COMPLETED') AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM solve_task WHERE task_status='QUEUED' AND available_time<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND deleted=0 ORDER BY available_time ASC,id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE solve_task SET task_status='RUNNING',lease_token=#{leaseToken},lease_until=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND),attempt_count=attempt_count+1,start_time=COALESCE(start_time,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status='QUEUED' AND deleted=0

UPDATE solve_task SET task_status='COMPLETED',termination_reason=#{terminationReason},stats_json=CAST(#{statsJson} AS JSON),lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,finish_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND deleted=0

UPDATE solve_task SET task_status='FAILED',termination_reason='ERROR',error_code=#{errorCode},stats_json=CAST(#{statsJson} AS JSON),lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,finish_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND task_status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND deleted=0

UPDATE solve_task SET task_status='CANCELLED',termination_reason='CANCELLED',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,finish_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND task_status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO solve_result(id,create_time,update_time,create_by,update_by,deleted,task_id,proof_status,winner_side,proof_value,strategy_status,root_node_id,winning_lines_json,stats_json,verified_time) VALUES(#{id},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),NULL,NULL,0,#{taskId},#{proofStatus},#{winnerSide},#{proofValue},#{strategyStatus},#{rootNodeId},CAST(#{winningLinesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{statsJson} AS JSON),#{verifiedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM solve_task WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND deleted=0 AND task_status=#{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM solve_task WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND deleted=0 AND task_status=#{status}
